purpose: Expand approved immersive visual design to all nine existing CheckInType contexts; approval-only design

boards.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. New NutriGuide design board, landscape1536x1024, TWO very large straight-on phone screens. Reference is the approved immersive wellness visual language ONLY: generous big rounded rectangular tiles, large clear pictograms, concise Turkish labels, premium celestial folded-dune horizon, modern typography. Preserve that visual quality. This board restores the NINE REAL EXISTING check-in options in the code, not just the previous 3 theme examples. Both phones show one optional daily selection screen with two tabs "Günlük" and "Regl dönemi". Neutral midnight navy page frame before selection; selectable tiles preview their full mood palettes. Large heading "Bugün nasılsın?", short helper "Bugün öne çıkan durumu seç." Do not imply diagnosis. Every choice is a large card with big icon, short label and small circled i. A tap selects one primary context; no second Apply button. Bottom "Şimdilik atla".
LEFT phone: Günlük selected tab. A 2-column 3-row grid of SIX LARGE rectangles, about150x150 per tile:
1 "Düşük Enerji", big low battery pictogram, matte warm plum #3B2E45 with champagne icon/text.
2 "Şişkinlik", big simple relaxed waist/soft outward curved lines pictogram, LIGHT sage green #D7E3CB with dark forest #233B2E icon/text.
3 "Tatlı İsteği", big simple cookie pictogram, deep cocoa #3B2924 with caramel cream icon/text.
4 "Odaklanamıyorum", big crisp concentric focus rings pictogram, deep ink indigo #202E50 with pale icy periwinkle icon/text.
5 "Egzersiz Sonrası", big dumbbell pictogram, dark mineral teal #16474D with ice mint icon/text.
6 "Belirli Bir Sorun Yok", big balanced circle with small leaf, approved calm jade #19464A with pearl icon/text. Label may wrap two lines, readable.
Each tile has its own subtle miniature horizon in BACKGROUND below/away from text. More icons than text, no descriptions. Normalcase labels are okay but correct Turkish wording. All six fit above skip.
RIGHT phone: exact same header/layout family, Regl dönemi selected tab. THREE BIG full-width wide rectangular cards stacked with clear big glyph left, label center, circled i right:
"PMS / Adet Öncesi" dusty rose mauve #573945, icon simple heart beside calendar;
"Regl Krampları" warm terracotta clay #713F32, icon three rounded warm wave lines within a soft circle (no hospital cross, no treatment suggestion);
"Regl Yorgunluğu" smoky midnight lilac #38334F, icon crescent beside a low battery.
Warm ivory text on these dark cards, premium subtle corresponding horizons, no stereotyped pink glitter, no gender silhouettes, no health promises or fake pain numbers. Small short text below cards "Göstereceğin alanları sen seçersin." This section is voluntarily opened, not inferred from appearance. Bottom same skip. No bottom navigation on either daily chooser.
Outside title "01 / Kodda bulunan 9 durum". Footer "Tasarım önerisi · Mevcut seçenekler korunur". Do not add Sakinim/Enerjik as additional diagnostic choices on this screen; those remain separate optional appearance presets. These are concept drawings, not running app screenshots.

Use case: ui-mockup. NutriGuide immersive check-in themes board02, landscape1536x1024, THREE equal large front-facing phone home screens. Match attached approved visual language and geometry exactly: huge simple pictograms, large rounded rectangular feature tiles, very little text, celestial horizon, warm natural food image, readable native-looking Turkish UI. Each phone is the same home screen with a DIFFERENT full-app palette. All surfaces, header, cards, text, buttons, icons and bottom nav change, not merely accents. Keep layout stable.
Outside board title "02 / Günlük durumlar". Column labels "Düşük Enerji", "Şişkinlik", "Tatlı İsteği".
Common contents EVERY phone: small NutriGuide/N avatar; big "Bugün"; short chip bearing its column's exact condition label; compact atmospheric header; wide food entry card with natural warm bowl photo, simple label "Beslenme" and action "Tarifleri gör", circled i. This is a generic entry to recipes, NOT a medical meal recommendation. Under it 2x2 big tiles with identical large pictograms and labels: flowing waves "Nefes", crescent "Uyku", walking person "Hareket", drop "Su". Every tile has small circled i. Bottom row with sliders glyph "Durumu değiştir". Bottom 5-tab nav labels EXACT "Bugün", "Keşfet", "Plan", "Gelişim", "Profil"; Bugün selected. No fake medical scores, no pain ratings, no treatment claims, no extra prose.
LEFT Düşük Enerji: approved warm plum velvet world, canvas #241C2C, opaque matte mauve card #3B2E45, ivory #FFF1E7, champagne #E8C6AE functional icons/action. Honey crescent over soft rounded velvet folds in compact header. Exactly the warmth of approved left reference.
CENTER Şişkinlik: an unmistakably LIGHT SAGE world, pale sage canvas #EEF2E6, opaque eucalyptus card #D7E3CB, dark forest #233B2E text and ALL icons, deeper forest #355D46 primary action with ivory text. Pale sage soft dune/leaf-curved horizon, very broad quiet shapes, muted olive celestial disc. Matteness and breathing room, no blue panel anywhere. This aesthetic does NOT promise bloating relief. It is distinct from teal dark reference and apricot.
RIGHT Tatlı İsteği: deep COCOA world, canvas #251A17, opaque cacao card #3B2924, cream #FFF0DE text, soft caramel #E3BC87 ALL functional icons/primary action. Silky cocoa dune horizon and small cream celestial crescent, rich matte chocolate surfaces. No candy photography, sugar crystals, calorie guilt, red warning or diet messaging. Natural food picture same as other phones, no change to real food colors.
Strongly different dominant backgrounds visible even thumbnail size; preserve all card positions and shapes. Slim consistent phone frames, warm cream outside board. Footer "Tasarım önerisi · Tema ve yerleşim karşılaştırması". All Turkish labels exact.

Use case: ui-mockup. NutriGuide immersive daily-context design board03, landscape1536x1024, THREE equal large front-facing phone home screens. Attached approved image is the design language: large icon-first rounded rectangular tiles, strong FULL-APP mood palettes, modern typography, celestial dune horizon, stable layout. This board must show three more REAL code contexts. Every surface and control changes with the palette, not just a header accent.
Outside title "03 / Odak, hareket ve günlük denge". Column labels EXACT: "Odaklanamıyorum", "Egzersiz Sonrası", "Belirli Bir Sorun Yok".
COMMON UI on every phone: NutriGuide small/N circle; large "Bugün"; readable condition chip matching column label (long label may wrap within a roomy chip); compact abstract atmospheric header; large wide generic "Beslenme" entry with natural warm bowl photo and small action "Tarifleri gör" plus i; 2x2 big rectangles with identical icons/labels: flowing waves "Nefes", crescent "Uyku", walking "Hareket", droplet "Su". Circled i each. Sliders row "Durumu değiştir". Same 5-tab nav "Bugün", "Keşfet", "Plan", "Gelişim", "Profil"; Bugün selected. No diagnosis, no invented health readings, no prescription or guaranteed benefit. Only concise labels.
LEFT Odaklanamıyorum: MATTE INK/INDIGO world, entire canvas #111C33, opaque card surfaces #202E50, clear pale periwinkle functional icons/action #C0CBF4, bright soft white text #F0F3FF. Very restrained broad geometric horizon arc and thin focused light disc, minimal texture and no star particles. Stable quiet structure, not psychedelic. It should look substantially different from the plum tired world.
CENTER Egzersiz Sonrası: MINERAL PETROL world, entire canvas #0C3038, opaque teal-blue cards #16474D, ice mint #ACDFDD ALL functional icons/action, pearl #EEF9F6 text, smooth dark mineral dune surfaces with crisp icy top-edge lighting, restrained freshwater arc. This is AFTER exercise, not assumption user is energetic. No flames, medals, heartbeat/HRV/readiness numbers, aggressive sports imagery, or forced exercise action. Keep same 4 familiar tools.
RIGHT Belirli Bir Sorun Yok: approved CALM JADE world, canvas #0D3033, cards #19464A, pearl #EDF8EE text, soft jade #B9DFCF functional icons/buttons, quiet still-water horizon and pearl crescent. A balanced default appearance; do NOT label person happy or energetic. Full theme covers nav, inactive icons, header and dividers.
Warm neutral cream outside phones. Footer "Tasarım önerisi · Mevcut durumlara yeni görünüm". Phone sizes and all control positions identical. Natural food colors unchanged. Ensure correct Turkish spelling, generous text size and no clipping.

Use case: ui-mockup. NutriGuide board04: THREE equal large straight-on phone HOME screens, landscape1536x1024. Match approved reference design precisely in structure: generous rounded rectangular icon tiles, premium atmospheric horizon, little text, beautiful readable Turkish, SAME positions for all tools. This board gives the THREE DISTINCT existing menstrual-context choices their own complete visual worlds. Not medical advice, not treatment, not a new cycle prediction tracker. Avoid pink glitter, gender silhouettes, stereotypical female cartoons, bloody imagery, red warning aesthetics and pain score numbers.
Outside title "04 / Regl döneminde, seçtiğin duruma göre". Column headings EXACT "PMS / Adet Öncesi", "Regl Krampları", "Regl Yorgunluğu".
Common UI ALL phones: small NutriGuide/N avatar; big title "Bugün"; condition chip same as column heading; short calm line "Kendi ritminde." Compact horizon; a wide rectangular generic entry "Beslenme" with natural warm food bowl photo, action "Tarifleri gör" and circled i. No wording food treats cramps. Under it identical 2x2 LARGE feature cards, large simple icons with short labels: wave "Nefes", moon "Uyku", walking person "Hareket", drop "Su". Each card has a small i. Sliders row "Durumu değiştir". Same five-tab nav "Bugün", "Keşfet", "Plan", "Gelişim", "Profil", Bugün selected in its theme. No visible fake completed tasks.
LEFT PMS / Adet Öncesi: DUSTY ROSE DUSK world, entire canvas #34242D, opaque muted rose-mauve card surfaces #573945, ivory #FFF0EC text, muted champagne rose #F1C7B5 icons/action. Broad smooth petal-like dune folds and soft ivory crescent, rich dusk not candy pink, precise contrast.
CENTER Regl Krampları: WARM TERRACOTTA world, entire canvas #422821, opaque clay cards #713F32, warm cream #FFF0DF text, pale apricot gold #F6CEA2 icons/action. Rounded low sandstone/clay folds with diffuse amber celestial light. Sense of softness and warmth as art direction, NOT a heat therapy recommendation; no hot-water-bottle treatment, no uterus graphic. All surfaces including nav are distinctly clay/brown, no leftover purple or navy.
RIGHT Regl Yorgunluğu: SMOKY LILAC NIGHT world, entire canvas #231F35, opaque muted lavender cards #38334F, pale pearl #F2EFFA text, desaturated lilac #D4C7EF icons/action. Quiet broad satin folds, pearl low crescent, very little texture. Distinct from rose and terracotta; a slightly cooler sibling of approved tired-plum theme.
Every phone's screen background, cards, icons, texts, buttons, borders, inactive navigation and menu fill follow its palette, not simply accents. Natural food photo stays true-colored and consistent across phones as generic navigation imagery. Warm cream outside-board background and footer "Tasarım önerisi · Üç durum ayrı korunur". Modern implementation-feasible app UI, no long prose.
